title: Symmetry and Patterns
summary: Lines of symmetry, rangoli and quilt patterns, and shapes that tile.

cbse.chapter: Maths Mela (2025) Ch 7: Shapes and Patterns

objectives: I can find lines of symmetry.
I can continue and make patterns.
I can say which shapes tile without gaps.
misconceptions: Every shape has a line of symmetry.
A rectangle’s diagonals are lines of symmetry.
Circles can tile a floor without gaps.
